title: KeyManagerStoredValueDeletedPayload

kind.description: What holds a stored value Move can take: forge-account (a forge account's pasted token) or endpoint (a webhook endpoint's pasted secret).

id.description: The item's id with its owner: a forge account's id or a webhook endpoint's name.

item.description: An item Move takes, by its kind and its owner's id for it.

storedAt.description: Where the stored value was kept.

description: key-manager.stored-value-deleted: a stored value a move left behind, its delete having failed, was deleted at a later start; recorded as system:key-manager.
